what: LANDED FIRST (2026-09-24): the owner has landed PRs #8033-#8993 on main with narrowed or corrected statements, and origin/main is the science authority. Read each named note as landed (git show origin/main:docs/<note>; find its path with gh pr view <n> --json files) BEFORE any PR branch. Wherever this problem's SETTING paraphrases a claim that the landed note narrows or withdraws, the landed version controls: say so in ATTEMPT.md and do not build on the withdrawn wording. Known narrowings: block 54's exact packet force is withdrawn (T3 is a finite-power identity, the evolution form is conditional on a self-adjoint realization, T4 is a conditional ray model); block 55's point-force coupling is not gamma; the ray statements of blocks 59-60 are local same-point comparisons, not integrated turns; block 66's lattice force is leading order; block 77's corner energies are not established as rest masses; blocks 90-93 are conditional comparators under the excluded re-recording clause; block 95's pair law is a neutralized torus law; block 98 has no nonlinear bending or changed-length result; block 108's domains rest on the stated endpoint theory and its inverse-clock sum is not an arrival-time theorem. WORKED COMPUTATION (independent run 1 of 2): SETTING (blocks 39, 40, 41; open PRs titled 'ail39: records that move', 'ail40', 'ail41: what a source is'): records move and carry their content; a site is empty or holds one record (content = one of the six axes); two neighbouring records weigh W = c * omega (omega = p, q, r for equal, opposite, orthogonal contents), a bond with an empty end weighs 1, a record weighs z; the neutral scale is c_0 = 6/(p+q+4r), at which every row of W sums to 6 and records do not bind on any window without a cycle (all binding is the loop factor 1 + 3 l_1^n + 2 l_2^n, l_1 = (p-q)/(p+q+4r), l_2 = (p+q-2r)/(p+q+4r)). Motion: a record hops to an empty neighbour, choosing between its two positions in proportion to the pair weights it would have there (an isolated record hops symmetrically). Formation: an empty site x forms a record at rate z Z_x, Z_x = sum over contents a of the product of W(a, s_y) over the recorded neighbours y, content drawn in proportion to the summand; records are never removed. BLOCK 41 PROVED: (1) the only local additive invariant density is the occupancy: mass = number of records; (2) two sets of records separated by empty sites weigh the product of their weights, at any scale: no action across empty sites; (3) the field of a held record through a medium is the pair correlation, of short range (ladder exact; cubic lattice about one step or less away from the clumping onset); (4) the content field around a record is a number times its content vector, zero for a record of unread content: the mass has no charge in the long-range tilt channel; (5) under symmetric hops with one record per site d<n_x>/dt = kappa * (lattice Laplacian of <n>)_x + j_x exactly, j the mean formation rate, so a steady excess of production carries the stationary halo G * (j - mean j)/kappa with G the lattice Green function (one-over-distance on Z^3); at the neutral scale the formation rate next to ONE record is exactly the void's (Z_x = 6), next to records of independent uniform contents it is the void's on average, and next to k agreeing records it is larger by 6^(k-1) (p^k+q^k+4r^k)/(p+q+4r)^k (13/12, 5/4 at (3,1,2); 46/21, 2348/343 at (12,1,2); k = 2, 3). NOT YET KNOWN: what a lump's halo looks like, how strong it is, and what a second lump does inside it. The interaction of two vacancies in the quadratic model, computed. On tori of side 8, 12, 16, 24: build the lattice Laplacian with the six bonds at site x and at site y removed (stiffness 0), compute F(x,y) = (1/2)(log det' L_both - log det' L_x - log det' L_y + log det' L_none) with det' the determinant without the zero mode (the vacated sites decouple: treat their free modes consistently, say how), for separations r = 1..L/2 along an axis and along the body diagonal. Report the sign, fit the decay exponent (expected 6) with finite-size care, and compare with the two-held-tilts interaction -a b G(r)/(G(0)^2 - G(r)^2) at a = b = 1. Floating point is fine here; give residuals.
